disclosure: All values are synthetic. Texture indices are arbitrary proxies, not calibrated gelation or food-safety measures.
sample_unit: one simulated egg; white/yolk paired by sample_id
batch_unit: four synthetic process groups; time points are not independent samples

columns.white_index: 0-10; synthetic setting proxy; larger means firmer
columns.yolk_index: 0-10; synthetic softness proxy; creamy target is an interval, not maximum softness
columns.nominal_mass_g: design stratum; actual mass has generated variation
columns.protocol_deviation: B04 periodic keeps total duration fixed but changes duty cycle; not excluded

generation_model: dTw/dt=(Tb-Tw)/tau_w; dTy/dt=(Tw-Ty)/tau_y; accumulated exponential rate proxies; see protocol.json
